finalText:
Build is green now (exit 0, 0 errors). The remaining 8 warnings are all genuine deprecation noise from the bump (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, `DEP0233`, etc., plus a couple of dead-code/circular-import notices) — not build blockers.

Two real regressions from the bump were hiding in that noise, both in the link stage:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the bumped bundler now passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries` (undefined), crashing on `.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but `isBackoffEnabled` only accepted strict `true`/`false` and threw otherwise. Added an `undefined` → `false` case so it degrades the same way the old loader did.
